metadata.description: Musk's algorithm as a clean-context critic for plans, diffs, UX, and workflows.

plugins.name: elonify
plugins.description: A first-principles critic for decisions and diffs: questions every requirement back to a named owner, then deletes before it simplifies, accelerates, or automates (Musk's algorithm, in order). Works before building (plans) and after (diffs), at code, UI/UX, and workflow altitude. Optional Stop hook.
